invariants.description: the regulation function (exact): f = x^n/(1 + x^n), x = C/K for ATP, G6P and glucose, x = K_H/H_i for H+
invariants.expr: np.allclose(f_ATP_reg, (np.maximum(cyto__C_ATP, 0)/K_ATP_reg)**n_reg/(1 + (np.maximum(cyto__C_ATP, 0)/K_ATP_reg)**n_reg), rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-15) and np.allclose(f_G6P_reg, (np.maximum(cyto__C_G6P, 0)/K_G6P_reg)**n_reg/(1 + (np.maximum(cyto__C_G6P, 0)/K_G6P_reg)**n_reg), rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-15) and np.allclose(f_glc_reg, (np.maximum(cyto__C_glc, 0)/K_glc_reg)**n_reg/(1 + (np.maximum(cyto__C_glc, 0)/K_glc_reg)**n_reg), rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-15) and np.allclose(f_H_reg, ((K_H_reg/H__H_i))**n_reg/(1 + ((K_H_reg/H__H_i))**n_reg), rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-15)
np.all((f_ATP_reg >= 0) & (f_ATP_reg <= 1)) and np.all((f_G6P_reg >= 0) & (f_G6P_reg <= 1)) and np.all((f_glc_reg >= 0) & (f_glc_reg <= 1)) and np.all((f_H_reg >= 0) & (f_H_reg <= 1))

invariants.description: the pool switched to ATP regulation (target 1) goes to f_ATP (exact), and while the cytosol's ATP runs down, f_ATP and the target fall with it
invariants.expr: np.allclose(pool_a__R_reg, f_ATP_reg, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(pool_a__m_goal, f_ATP_reg, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.all(np.diff(f_ATP_reg)*np.diff(cyto__C_ATP) >= -1e-15)

bc_sweep.rationale: steepness from graded to switch-like; half-way points from a tenth of the resting ATP to rest, and for H+ from rest to 0.6 pH units below
